stemMd: Solve (x squared−4)/(x−2)=0 over its real domain.
explanationMd: A rational expression is zero when its numerator is zero and denominator nonzero. Numerator roots are ±2, but x=2 is excluded. At −2 the denominator is −4, so the expression is zero.

distractorRationale.e: One numerator root is excluded by the denominator.
